scenario.quote: Name: Return pet toys from floor to pet toy bin

other.name: Return pet toys from floor to pet toy bin

objects.name: pet toy
objects.role: item to be picked up from the floor and placed into the bin
objects.quote: Pet toys (plush toys, rubber balls, rope toys, etc.).

objects.name: pet toy bin
objects.role: container to hold the pet toys

starting_state.fact: There are 2 to 4 pet toys present.
starting_state.quote: Items: 2–4 pet toys (plush, rubber, rope, ball).

starting_state.fact: The toys are scattered in random positions on the floor.
starting_state.quote: Position: Scattered on the floor in random positions.

steps.text: Walk to the toy and stand still for 1 second.
steps.quote: 1. Walk to the toy and stand still for 1 second.

steps.text: Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up the toy with one hand, wrapping your fingers around the widest part.
steps.quote: 2. Start with arms in a neutral position. Pick up the toy with one hand, wrapping your fingers around the widest part.

steps.text: Walk to the bin and stop for 1 second.
steps.quote: 3. Walk to the bin and stop for 1 second.

steps.text: Hold the toy over the bin opening and release.
steps.quote: 4. Hold the toy over the bin opening and release.

repeat.end_condition: all pet toys are returned to the bin
repeat.quote: Items: 2–4 pet toys (plush, rubber, rope, ball).

acceptance.criterion: The fingers are wrapped around the widest part of the toy when picked up.
acceptance.quote: wrapping your fingers around the widest part

constraints.rule: Do not throw toys into bin.
constraints.violation_looks_like: The person throws or tosses the toy toward or into the bin instead of holding it over the opening and releasing it.
constraints.quote: Do not throw toys into bin.

not_modelled.reason: Instruction for resetting the environment between recordings.
not_modelled.quote: Reset: Randomize positions and vary toy types each episode.

not_modelled.reason: Instruction on varying parameters across data collection recordings.
not_modelled.quote: Diversity: Vary toy types (plush, rubber, rope). Change positions on floor. Vary number of items (2–4). Change bin location.
